=== 硬件特定文本测试 ===

Text: cuda -keys=cuda,gpu -arch=sm_70 -max_num_threads=1024
  V100: ['cuda', '-keys=cuda,gpu', '-arch=sm_70', '-max_num_threads=1024']... (UNK: 0)
  Multi: ['cuda', '-keys=cuda,gpu', '-arch=sm_70', '-max_num_threads=1024']... (UNK: 0)
